texts.en: The first stage of constructing a Mega Art Installation combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priority. Planned to be a marvel of security and stability, the Vault will contain and protect the artistic wealth of the galaxy.

The text of 9002 varies with ethics (e.g. xenophile; megastructure_events_1.txt:3718-3745).

texts.zh: 我们巨型艺术设施的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。
texts.en: The second stage of our Mega Art Installation is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are being built to house the multitude of required staff, and to display a vast number of exhibits.

texts.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
texts.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

summary.text:
# 巨型艺术设施 / Mega Art Installation

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Megacorp（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工巨型艺术设施（见 common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Mega Art Installation inside your borders (common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. mega.9000：初始阶段建成 / Nascency stage built
2. mega.9001：成熟阶段建成 / Maturity stage built
3. mega.9002：巨型艺术设施完工 / Installation completed

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- 无（该巨型结构不向其他帝国发送专门通知）/ none (this megastructure sends no dedicated notices to other empires)
- 废墟 The ruin：mega.9120（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_mega_art_installation_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；mega.9121 在修复完成后出现。
  mega.9120 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). mega.9121 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.
- 9002 的正文按帝国伦理（如亲异）有所不同（megastructure_events_1.txt:3718-3745）。 The text of 9002 varies with ethics (e.g. xenophile; megastructure_events_1.txt:3718-3745).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
